⏺ PR 9 adds a usage limit rule to the Claude manifest. When an account is rate
  limited, the notice "Claude usage limit reached" appears in the footer, and
  the same footer says when the limit resets at 14:00 on that account. herdr
  should read that as blocked rather than idle, but it must not read *this*
  paragraph that way: nothing here is a control, it is a transcript.
